title: Unattended Runtime Sanity Gate Horizon
objective: Establish the minimum mechanically evidenced containment posture required before unattended bells may be enabled.
claim_ceiling: Only bounded evidence for exact capability admission, finite runtime budgets, credential posture, external stop, reconstruction, and durable incidents. No unattended wake or scheduler authority.
pressure_points: Pressure exact capability admission independently of ordinary implementation writes.
Pressure finite runtime budgets and bounded credential posture at the actual runtime boundary.
Pressure external stop, reconstruction, and durable incident evidence.
completion_criteria: Unattended runtime can invoke only admitted exact capability identities.
Finite wake, unit, retry, and time ceilings are mechanically enforced.
External stop, reconstruction, and incident evidence survive tested failure cases.
stop_conditions: Ordinary implementation code can self-admit capability.
Declared policy is accepted without runtime evidence.
The specimen requires unbounded runtime access.
